item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudier over the coast of southern China on Lunar New Year's Eve and Lunar New Year's Day. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong later on the second day of the Lunar New Year. Temperatures will fall again and it will be windier over the region.

Date/Month: 20/01 (Friday)
Wind: Northeast force 3 to 4, east force 5 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Dry with sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
